en:
No, Rantaro was not the only one in
the library at the time the murder occurred.
This <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk Monopad<CLT=cltNORMAL> is proof of that.
Why would that Monopad be evidence?

The Monopad was given exclusively to Rantaro
as his Survivor Perk, correct?

But when we searched Rantaro's body, he didn't
have it on his person.
He only had his <CLT=cltSTRONG>student handbook Monopad<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Which means that someone took this Monopad
from Rantaro after the murder!
Wow! That's what we've been saying!

What? Ugh, keep quiet, will you? I don't
have time for your nonsense right now.

Really, I have no clue what anyone
is talking about...

If we don't chime in soon, Pops is
gonna push the detonator!

Then we better not let these fuckin'
chumps run their mouths anymore!
